edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares, subject to the adjustment mechanics set forth in this Section 1. At least five (5) Business Days prior to Closing, Seller shall deliver to Buyer a good-faith closing statement setting forth Seller’s calculation of the Purchase Price, including the estimated net working capital, cash, indebtedness, transaction expenses, and any other agreed adjustments. Within thirty (30) days after Closing, Buyer shall deliver to Seller a post-Closing adjustment statement setting forth Buyer’s calculation of the final Purchase Price. If Seller disputes any item in Buyer’s statement, Seller shall deliver a written notice of dispute within fifteen (15) days after receipt, specifying in reasonable detail the items disputed and the basis for the dispute. The parties shall use commercially reasonable efforts for fifteen (15) days thereafter to resolve any dispute, failing which the disputed items shall be submitted to an independent accounting firm mutually selected by the parties (or, if they cannot agree, selected by the American Arbitration Association) for final and binding determination, acting as an expert and not as an arbitrator. The Purchase Price shall be adjusted dollar-for-dollar based on the final determination, and any amount owed by one party to the other shall be paid within five (5) Business Days after the final determination, together with interest from the Closing Date at the prime rate plus two percent (2%) per annum.
edits.name: Purchase price mechanics

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur on the date mutually agreed by the parties, which date shall be no later than forty-five (45) days after signing, or such other date as the parties may agree in writing. Closing shall take place remotely by exchange of executed documents and funds, unless the parties agree otherwise, and shall occur promptly following satisfaction or waiver of the conditions precedent set forth in this Agreement.
edits.name: Closing timing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents, to the Seller’s knowledge and except as disclosed in the disclosure schedules, that the financial statements are accurate in all material respects and fairly present the financial condition of the Company in conformity with the applicable accounting principles consistently applied. For purposes of this Agreement, “Seller’s knowledge” means the actual knowledge, after reasonable inquiry, of the individuals identified in the disclosure schedules.
edits.name: Representations qualifier

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller indemnifies the Buyer against undisclosed liabilities, subject to customary limitations including a de minimis threshold, basket, survival period, and an agreed cap, except in cases of fraud or willful misconduct. The foregoing limitations shall apply except to the extent the relevant claim is based on fraud, intentional misrepresentation, or willful misconduct, and nothing in this Agreement shall limit recovery for such claims to the extent prohibited by applicable law.
edits.name: Indemnity limitations
